notes: H. Con. Res. 68 is a one-sentence concurrent resolution (Introduced in House, IH) invoking section 5(c) of the War Powers Resolution (50 U.S.C. 1544(c)) to direct the President to remove U.S. Armed Forces from Venezuela unless explicitly authorized by a declaration of war or specific statutory authorization for use of military force. Every substantive bill-content claim (summary, brief, top_lines, section label/main/detail, gaps) traces to the single operative sentence and the resolving clause; no figure error, direction inversion, wrong-account, or fabricated-entity issue found. likelihoodReason vote/stage claims (Failed in House, Jan 22 2026, 215-215 tie, matter closed) are not present in the Introduced bill text and were verified against votes[]/stage metadata per the rubric step-4 cross-check (empty sourceSpan on those rows) — all consistent, no stage/vote drift. One minor coverage omission: prose does not note the McGovern/Massie cross-party co-submission (captured via cosponsor metadata). featured_quotes[] are Congressional Record floor quotes (Deluzio, Ryan) that are not in the fetched bill source and were out of scope for this bill-text audit. 0 material issues.
